nodes.name: __init__

nodes.name: DACCConfig
nodes.summary: Frozen-form dataclass carrying all sub-weights, precision/effort constants, MECH-268 saturation knobs, SD-034 pe_cap hook, and SD-057 L7 goal-readout controls for the dACC adaptive-control cluster; every knob defaults to zero/false so the module is no-op unless explicitly activated via REEConfig.use_dacc.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl
nodes.summary: Stateful non-trainable dACC/aMCC-analog module that integrates precision-weighted affective PE (MECH-258), Shenhav EVC per-candidate expected value, Croxson reward-x-effort interaction, Kolling foraging value, MECH-260 recency suppression, MECH-268 outcome-history saturation, and Scholl 2017 drive-gated coupling into a per-tick control-plane bundle.

nodes.name: DACCtoE3Adapter
nodes.summary: Stopgap adapter converting a DACCAdaptiveControl integration bundle into an additive per-candidate E3 score bias with an absolute clamp and an independent SD-057 L7 (MECH-348) object-discriminative goal-readout term; to be removed once SD-032a salience-network coordinator lands.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl.__init__
nodes.summary: Initialises the dACC module's per-episode state: PE EMA slot, action-history ring for MECH-260, outcome-history FIFO for MECH-268 saturation, and per-tick diagnostic slots used by experiment scripts.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl._affective_pe
nodes.summary: MECH-258 precision-weighted affective prediction error pipeline: forms ||z_harm_a - z_harm_a_pred||, applies precision-normalised gain, clamps to SD-034 dacc_pe_cap, then attenuates by the MECH-268 history-conditioned saturation factor for the current outcome class.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl._saturation_factor
nodes.summary: MECH-268 f_sat computation: counts recurrences of the current outcome class within the recent outcome-history window and returns a habituation multiplier plus the recurrence count, returning 1.0 when saturation is disabled or the class cannot be determined.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl.record_outcome
nodes.summary: Pushes an outcome class onto the MECH-268 saturation FIFO with a bounded double-window buffer; ClosureOperator clears this on rule-completion firing.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl._suppression_penalty
nodes.summary: MECH-260 per-candidate recency penalty: fraction of the recent action-history ring occupied by the queried action class, used to suppress monostrategy re-selection.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl.inject_nogo
nodes.summary: SD-034 targeted No-Go: injects a completed action class into the MECH-260 recency ring multiple times to bias the striatum away from re-selection, clipped by history memory.

nodes.name: DACCAdaptiveControl.forward
nodes.summary: Core per-tick dACC integration: computes precision-weighted PE, Shenhav EVC mode_ev, Croxson reward-x-effort interaction, choice difficulty, MECH-260 per-candidate suppression penalties, Kolling foraging value, SD-049 per-axis drive-gated coupling, and packages the full control-plane bundle including SD-057 L7 goal-readout and MECH-268 saturation diagnostics.

nodes.name: DACCtoE3Adapter.forward
nodes.summary: Converts a DACCAdaptiveControl bundle into a per-candidate E3 score bias by combining -mode_ev, Croxson interaction, Kolling foraging, and MECH-260 suppression terms with drive-gated dacc_weight and an absolute clamp, then adds an independently-weighted SD-057 L7 goal-readout term after the clamp so goal-conditioned bias survives even when the legacy dACC path is off.

nodes.name: goal.py

nodes.name: GoalConfig

nodes.name: IncentiveTokenBank

nodes.name: GoalState
nodes.summary: Persistent z_goal attractor with EMA update, drive-gated seeding threshold, SD-092 hierarchical parent-goal credit, SD-093 progress-velocity effort modulation, and MECH-188 injection view for scoring.

nodes.name: serotonin.py

nodes.name: SerotoninConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass for SerotoninModule dynamics: baseline, benefit sensitivity, harm suppression, decay rate, phase-specific factors, plus SR-2/SR-3 gains and MECH-204 REM recalibration knobs.

nodes.name: SerotoninModule

nodes.name: structured_curiosity.py
nodes.summary: Pure-arithmetic MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus regulator combining novelty (314a), uncertainty (314b), and learning-progress (314c) sub-flavors into a per-candidate E3 score bias with auto-augmentation streak tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Sibling-pattern regulator (no nn.Module, no learned params) exposing three independently-togglable sub-flavours for Q-044 ablation; MECH-094 simulation-mode gated.

nodes.name: StructuredCuriosityConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding MECH-314 curiosity master switch, three sub-flavour flags, per-flavour weights, clamp scale, LP EMA/window parameters, and Phase-2 novelty auto-augmentation controls.

nodes.name: StructuredCuriosity
nodes.summary: Pure-arithmetic curiosity regulator that composes MECH-314a novelty, MECH-314b uncertainty, and MECH-314c learning-progress into a clamped per-candidate score bias, honoring MECH-094 simulation-mode gating and tracking auto-augmentation streaks.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-nn.Module regulator with three orthogonally-toggleable channels; state is scalars/ring buffers only; broadcast Phase-1 for 314b/c with per-candidate 314a.

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Validates all StructuredCuriosityConfig sub-flags, weights, gains, thresholds, and window sizes; raises ValueError on any invalid setting before initializing counters and LP ring buffer.

nodes.name: compute_score_bias
nodes.summary: Main per-tick entry point that dispatches to Phase-2 novelty when enabled, composes weighted MECH-314a/b/c contributions into a K-length bias vector, clamps to +/-bias_scale, and records diagnostic ranges and rail hits.

nodes.name: _compute_novelty_phase2
nodes.summary: Phase-2 novelty computation that consumes coerced RBF centers, monitors candidate spread against the min-spread threshold, updates auto-augmentation streaks, and toggles first-action one-hot augmentation when the streak triggers.

nodes.name: _candidate_spread
nodes.summary: Computes mean pairwise L2 distance across K candidate summaries under no_grad as a scalar spread diagnostic feeding the auto-augmentation streak controller.

nodes.name: _update_augmentation_streak
nodes.summary: Advances or resets the consecutive-low-spread streak counter, flipping first-action one-hot augmentation on when the streak crosses the configured tick threshold.

nodes.name: _coerce_source_to_centers
nodes.summary: Normalizes heterogeneous novelty-source inputs (lists, tensors, arrays) into a detached [N,D] tensor on the target device for Phase-2 novelty processing.

nodes.name: _compute_novelty
nodes.summary: MECH-314a per-candidate novelty via minimum distance from each candidate's first-step z_world to the nearest active RBF center, optionally augmented with first-action one-hots, normalized by mean signature norm.

nodes.name: _compute_uncertainty
nodes.summary: MECH-314b uncertainty scalar read from E3 running variance, broadcast in Phase-1 across candidates and normalized to a nonnegative float.

nodes.name: update_prediction_error
nodes.summary: Feeds a per-tick prediction-error scalar into the MECH-314c learning-progress ring buffer and refreshes the LP EMA of |PE_t - PE_{t-K}|, gated by simulation_mode to protect replay paths.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Clears LP ring buffer, EMA state, augmentation streak/state, and per-tick diagnostic counters on episode reset.

nodes.name: get_state
nodes.summary: Returns a diagnostic dict of curiosity state including LP buffer size, EMA value, augmentation streak, and per-flavour contribution ranges for downstream logging and Q-044 ablation checks.

nodes.name: OPERATOR_GUIDE.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive operator guide for the Phase 3 coordinator/sync_daemon shadow-coordination system, covering the Explorer coordination panel, three-system architecture (git, coordinator API, sync_daemon writers), five-phase cutover, troubleshooting, hub telemetry transport, and daemon/config drift diagnostics.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive operator runbook with detailed troubleshooting for hub-writer wedge, daemon code drift, and unit config drift incidents; heavy cross-references to shadow.conf templates, service unit files, and phase3 environment gates.

nodes.name: manifest_spool.py
nodes.summary: Filesystem spool that lets the /result HTTP endpoint persist raw manifest bytes and companion sidefiles keyed on run_id, so the Phase 3 sole-git-writer in sync_daemon.py can later commit them into REE_assembly without touching git from the runner. Every write is atomic-rename with sha256 verification and gated on the COORDINATOR_SPOOL_DIR environment flag; layout is <spool>/pending/<run_id>.json plus <spool>/sidefiles/pending/<run_id>/<relpath>.
nodes.languageNotes: Filesystem-level path safety: every path is verified via resolve().relative_to(root) before touching disk, defending against traversal via crafted run_ids or manifest_relpaths from POST payloads.

nodes.name: spool_root
nodes.summary: Returns the configured COORDINATOR_SPOOL_DIR as a Path, or None when the env var is unset — the master feature switch for all spool writes.

nodes.name: write_manifest
nodes.summary: Atomically writes a manifest and its metadata sidecar for a given run_id: rejects unsafe run_ids, hashes-and-verifies incoming bytes, uses tmp-then-rename with fsync so a crash never leaves a half-file for the writer to consume.

nodes.name: count_pending
nodes.summary: Counts .json files currently sitting in the pending manifest directory — a health-check hook the coordinator exposes to detect backpressure.

nodes.name: list_pending_run_ids
nodes.summary: Enumerates run_ids with pending manifests, deduplicated by pairing .json and .meta.json files, so the writer can process each run atomically.

nodes.name: read_manifest
nodes.summary: Reads the raw manifest bytes for a pending run_id, returning None if either the run_id is unsafe or the file is missing (a caller may have already consumed it).

nodes.name: read_meta
nodes.summary: Reads the JSON metadata sidecar (received_at, sha, optional manifest_relpath hint) accompanying a pending manifest.

nodes.name: delete_manifest
nodes.summary: Removes the manifest and its metadata sidecar after a successful writer commit; tolerates missing files so partial-crash recovery is idempotent.

nodes.name: derive_evidence_relpath
nodes.summary: Resolves where in REE_assembly a manifest should land: prefers the runner-supplied manifest_relpath (validated safe), otherwise falls back to evidence/experiments/<run_id>.json to match the legacy flat layout.

nodes.name: safe_companion_relpath
nodes.summary: Validates a sidefile relative path against traversal and absolute-path attacks before it is used as a filesystem key inside the sidefile spool.

nodes.name: write_sidefile
nodes.summary: Spools a companion sidefile under <spool>/sidefiles/pending/<run_id>/<relpath> using tmp-then-rename with sha256 verification, so the writer can later either commit it alongside its manifest or quarantine it under the oversized threshold.

nodes.name: list_pending_sidefile_run_ids
nodes.summary: Enumerates run_ids that currently have queued sidefiles, so the writer can pair them with their manifest at commit time.

nodes.name: list_sidefiles_for_run
nodes.summary: Recursively lists every sidefile currently spooled for a given run_id along with its safe companion relpath, filtering out any traversal-unsafe entries a partial crash may have left behind.

nodes.name: delete_sidefiles
nodes.summary: Removes every sidefile and metadata for a run and cleans up empty parent directories, called by the writer after a successful commit of the run's sidefile set.

nodes.name: placemarker_relpath_for
nodes.summary: Returns the deterministic relpath under which an oversized-sidefile placemarker is stored — a small JSON stub that lives in git while the real payload sits in cloud storage.

nodes.name: sha256_of_file
nodes.summary: Streams a file through hashlib.sha256 in 1MB chunks to compute a stable content hash without loading the whole payload — used both to verify writes and to fingerprint oversized sidefiles in placemarkers.

nodes.name: build_oversized_sidefile_placemarker
nodes.summary: Constructs the JSON body of an oversized-sidefile placemarker recording the sha, size, oversized threshold, external storage locations, and a note explaining that the real bytes were quarantined off-git.

nodes.name: theta_buffer.py

nodes.name: ThetaBuffer

nodes.name: salience_coordinator.py

nodes.languageNotes: Pure-arithmetic regulator (no nn.Module, no learned parameters); non-trainable dataclass-config module with softmax mode-probability computation, MECH-266 asymmetric per-mode enter/exit thresholds, and MECH-048 mu/kappa temperature overlays.

nodes.name: SalienceCoordinatorConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding SalienceCoordinator tunables: mode affinity weights, external-task bias, softmax temperature, MECH-048 stability-temperature overlays, MECH-266 per-mode enter/exit hysteresis thresholds, salience-signal weights, and affinity input cap.

nodes.name: SalienceCoordinator

nodes.name: tick

nodes.name: _classify_commits
nodes.summary: Partitions a list of commit subject lines into writer-authored and foreign buckets using the WRITER_COMMIT_PREFIXES tuple; pure helper, unit-tested.

nodes.name: check_sync_daemon_phase3_tick

nodes.name: infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py
nodes.summary: Implements MECH-357 / SD-058: an infralimbic-PFC analogue that suppresses PAG-driven freezing and biases E3 candidate selection so an instrumental avoidance action can be released and its efficacy learned via a per-agent eligibility trace.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-arithmetic regulator (no nn.Module, no learned parameters); uses torch tensors only to shape the per-candidate score bias vector fed back into the E3 selector.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGateConfig
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding eligibility-trace, threat-scaling, scaffold-floor and action-bias parameters for the MECH-357 gate; defaults yield backward-compatible no-op behaviour at rest.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGateOutput
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass returned as a snapshot of the last gate tick — carries learned/effective avoidance efficacy, threat scale, freeze-suppression scalar, and bias magnitude for diagnostics.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate
nodes.summary: Non-trainable ilPFC-analog gate: computes per-candidate action bias favouring directed movement over the no-op class, emits a freeze-suppression scalar that overrides MECH-279 when threat and learned efficacy warrant, and updates the avoidance-efficacy EMA trace from realised outcomes.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate.__init__
nodes.summary: Initialises the gate from a config, clamping initial efficacy to [0, 1] and seeding EMA/threat traces and diagnostic counters used by later ticks and updates.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate.compute_action_bias
nodes.summary: Emits a per-candidate score-bias vector that penalises the no-op/freeze class in proportion to effective efficacy and threat, releasing directed instrumental actions without picking the escape direction itself.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate.update
nodes.summary: Runs the eligibility-trace acquisition step: on a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a it credits avoidance_efficacy toward 1; on freezing or failed avoidance it decays it, no-op under simulation_mode.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate.last_output
nodes.summary: Builds an InstrumentalAvoidanceGateOutput snapshot summarising current avoidance efficacy, effective efficacy, threat scale, freeze-suppression scalar and last bias magnitude for diagnostics and manifest recording.

nodes.name: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate.get_state
nodes.summary: Returns a flat dict of scalar gate diagnostics (efficacy, effective efficacy, credit/decay/threat/freeze-suppression counters) suitable for downstream manifest emission and inclusion in scaffold curriculum results.

nodes.name: _validate_abs_repo_path

nodes.name: _record_writer_commit

nodes.summary: SD-063 E2 conditional predictive-uncertainty head over (z_world, action): a distribution-free quantile network with online pinball-loss training, replay buffer, and predictive std / variance readouts that feed ARC-016's dynamic commit-precision gate.
nodes.languageNotes: Quantile/HL-Gauss / pinball design with online mini-batch training, careful CPU-only Adam construction on first use to avoid pre-move device drift.

nodes.name: E2WorldUncertaintyConfig
nodes.summary: Config dataclass for E2WorldUncertaintyHead: master switch, network dimensions, quantile levels, online training knobs (learning rate, replay capacity, batch size), and readiness threshold.

nodes.name: E2WorldUncertaintyHead
nodes.summary: SD-063 quantile head: MLP trunk producing per-dim quantile logits over configurable levels, pinball-loss training on a rolling replay buffer of (z_world_prev, action, z_world_next) triples, and predictive-std / variance readouts scored against ARC-016 precision floors for E3.

nodes.name: forward
nodes.summary: Runs the trunk MLP on the concatenated (z_world, action) input and reshapes the output into [B, z_world_dim, Q] quantile logits.

nodes.name: compute_loss
nodes.summary: Standard pinball / quantile-regression loss: max(lv*err, (lv-1)*err) averaged over batch, dims, and quantile levels for the predicted vs realised next z_world.

nodes.name: _ensure_optimizer
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs the CPU-only Adam optimiser at first training-step invocation, avoiding stale parameter references after device moves.

nodes.name: train_step
nodes.summary: One online SGD step on a single (z_world_prev, action, z_world_next) triple: shape/dtype normalisation, pinball forward+backward, optimiser step, training counter increment.

nodes.name: observe_transition
nodes.summary: Appends a detached (z_prev, a, z_next) triple to the rolling replay buffer, then draws a mini-batch and runs one train_step; consulted from the agent's E2 tick.

nodes.name: get_state
nodes.summary: Returns a diagnostics dict (train step count, observed transitions, replay capacity/size, readiness threshold, ready flag, quantile levels) for manifest logging.

nodes.name: predictive_std
nodes.summary: Reads the per-input predictive standard deviation as the sorted quantile IQR converted via a Gaussian-reference factor, averaged over dims.

nodes.name: predictive_variance
nodes.summary: Per-input predictive-variance readout (std^2, monotone rearranged for anti-crossing) with per-batch and per-dim diagnostics; the value ARC-016's dynamic commit-precision gate consumes.

nodes.name: e3_selector.py
nodes.summary: E3 trajectory selector: scores candidate trajectories on harm/benefit/residue/goal, arbitrates via a segregated cortico-basal-ganglia dual-system, and applies commitment gating to pick the next action.
nodes.languageNotes: Very large class (E3TrajectorySelector spans ~277-4381) implementing multi-cost scoring, WCI/precision recalibration, and a Go/No-Go eligibility gate over a symmetric residue field.

nodes.name: SelectionResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass carrying the chosen action index plus per-candidate diagnostic scores returned by E3.select.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector
nodes.summary: Core E3 selector: computes reality/harm/residue/goal/benefit costs over candidate trajectories from E2, applies precision-weighted arbitration and Go/No-Go eligibility, and yields the committed action.
nodes.languageNotes: 49 methods covering scoring, arbitration, WCI/precision maintenance, and post-action bookkeeping.

nodes.name: project_channel_range
nodes.summary: Projects a tensor into a bounded channel range with normalization and clipping used by cost-mixing paths.

nodes.name: authority_spread_ratio
nodes.summary: Computes the authority spread between top candidate scores, used to decide whether an arbitration outcome is decisive.

nodes.name: authority_ratio_is_competitive
nodes.summary: Boolean check on whether an authority spread ratio falls in the competitive (near-tie) band.

nodes.name: variance_commit_threshold
nodes.summary: Returns the variance-scaled threshold that gates whether the current WCI signal is confident enough to commit.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.select
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point: scores each trajectory, runs dual-system arbitration, applies commitment/eligibility gates and returns a SelectionResult with the chosen action.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.forward
nodes.summary: nn.Module forward hook that wraps select for callers using torch module semantics.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.score_trajectory
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-candidate reality, harm, residue, goal and benefit terms into a single scalar score for arbitration.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.compute_reality_cost
nodes.summary: Computes the reality-mismatch cost between a candidate's predicted world state and current observations.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.compute_harm_cost_fallback
nodes.summary: Fallback harm-cost path used when the primary harm-forward model is unavailable or gated off.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.compute_residue_cost
nodes.summary: Costs a trajectory against the residue field, capturing care-marker/regret signals that shape selection.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.compute_benefit_score
nodes.summary: Computes the benefit term rewarding progress toward viable, high-value outcomes.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.compute_goal_score
nodes.summary: Scores each trajectory against the active super-ordinal goal state from the goal memory.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.harm_eval
nodes.summary: Evaluates the harm-encoder head over candidate world states used to steer avoidance.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.benefit_eval
nodes.summary: Evaluates the benefit head/probability that a candidate reaches a viable state within horizon.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector._arbitrate_dual_system
nodes.summary: Runs the cortico-basal-ganglia dual-system arbitration that combines fast approach with cortical control to select a committed candidate.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector._go_nogo_eligibility_gate
nodes.summary: Applies the Go/No-Go eligibility gate that vetoes committing when uncertainty or harm risk is above threshold.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.post_action_update
nodes.summary: Post-hoc bookkeeping: updates precision estimates, running variance and channel eligibility after an action is committed.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.get_commitment_state
nodes.summary: Reports the current commitment state (threshold, current WCI, decisiveness margin) for external diagnostics.

nodes.name: E3TrajectorySelector.recalibrate_precision_to
nodes.summary: Recalibrates the internal precision estimate to a target volatility, used by outer feedback loops.

nodes.name: mel_consumer.py
nodes.summary: Implements the SD-MEL-CONSUMER substrate: an adaptive sleep-cadence Model Error Load (MEL) consumer that reads accumulated waking E3 prediction error and modulates sleep-phase duration (SWS/REM step scaling) and entry timing based on learning demand. Includes a Process-S time-integrating entry-pressure accumulator (SD-SLEEP-ENTRY-PRESSURE) fixing V3-EXQ-933.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dataclass config pattern with mirrored REEConfig knobs; pure-arithmetic regulator with no learned parameters or nn.Module inheritance.

nodes.name: phase_manager.py
nodes.summary: Defines SleepLoopManager, the deterministic K-episode driver for the SD-017 sleep cycle that orchestrates the SleepPhase FSM (WAKING -> SWS_ANALOG -> PHASE_SWITCH -> REM_ANALOG -> WRITEBACK). Coordinates Phase B-E consumers (MEL, replay sampler, routing gate, Bayesian/self-model aggregators, cross-module consolidator) and supports MECH-286 override-gated entry and GAP-9 within-life triggers.
nodes.languageNotes: Large orchestrator (851 lines) using TYPE_CHECKING for forward references to sibling sleep-cluster modules; welfare_relevant marker denotes pre-ethical descriptive tag, not a gate.

nodes.name: MELConsumerConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding knobs for the MEL consumer (gain, reference, EMA alpha, duration factor min/max, entry-pressure gain/threshold). Mirrored onto REEConfig for from_dims wiring.

nodes.name: WakingMELAccumulator
nodes.summary: Rolling accumulator computing the mean per-step waking E3 prediction error (MEL) across a wake window. Guards against non-finite inputs and matches the V3-EXQ-701c instrument convention.

nodes.name: EntryPressureAccumulator
nodes.summary: Process-S-style time-integrating running-sum accumulator of per-step waking demand used for the SD-SLEEP-ENTRY-PRESSURE entry-timing lever. Grows monotonically with waking steps; discharged on cycle completion so sustained sub-threshold demand crosses in bounded time.

nodes.name: MELConsumer
nodes.summary: Main MEL consumer that reads waking prediction error and produces relative novelty, duration-factor scaling for SWS/REM step counts, and entry-timing signals (need_crossed / entry_pressure_crossed / entry_permitted). Publishes metrics for cycle_history and honors MECH-094 by writing nothing to memory outside waking.

nodes.name: SleepPhase
nodes.summary: Enum defining the canonical sleep-cycle phase ordering (WAKING, SLEEP_ENTRY, SWS_ANALOG, PHASE_SWITCH, REM_ANALOG, WRITEBACK) shared across the sleep-aggregation cluster (Phases A-E).

nodes.name: SleepCycleState
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding per-cycle bookkeeping: cycle_index, current phase, episodes_since_sleep, GAP-9 steps_since_sleep counter, and last_metrics. Reset at the start of each sleep cycle.

nodes.name: SleepLoopManager
nodes.summary: K-episode driver for the SD-017 sleep cycle. Advances SleepCycleState through the phase FSM, integrates MEL-driven duration scaling and entry-pressure triggers, routes replay draws through the MECH-272 routing gate, updates Bayesian and self-model aggregators, and invokes cross-module consolidation and REM precision recalibration.
nodes.languageNotes: Composes many optional consumers via constructor injection; carries a `welfare_relevant` marker as a descriptive SENT-0 tag, not a runtime gate.

nodes.name: phase3_preflight.py
nodes.summary: Preflight verification script for the Phase-3 coordinator/runner cutover — inspects environment config, schema readiness, hub sync mode, fleet lifecycle state, and machine identity, then emits a staged pass/fail verdict before workers or writers are allowed to modify the coordination plane.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Python dataclasses for structured check results, subprocess for SSH probes, urllib for HTTP checks, and argparse for CLI staging. Read-only diagnostic — never mutates coordinator state, matching the preflight-guard convention.

nodes.name: CheckResult
nodes.summary: Immutable dataclass carrying a single preflight check's identifier, category, pass/fail status, human-readable message, optional detail, and blocking flag — the atomic unit aggregated into the final verdict.

nodes.name: _load_env_file
nodes.summary: Parses a KEY=VALUE .env-style file into a dict, skipping blank lines and comments — the entry point for coordinator credential and endpoint configuration.

nodes.name: _ssh_run
nodes.summary: Executes a remote command over SSH with timeout, honouring dry-run mode; returns (exit_code, stdout, stderr) for downstream check evaluation.

nodes.name: _http_get
nodes.summary: Fetches JSON from an authenticated coordinator HTTP endpoint, returning parsed body or an error string — used by the hub /shadow/status probe.

nodes.name: _run_check_shadow
nodes.summary: Invokes the bundled check_shadow.py helper via subprocess to run coordinator shadow-mode diagnostics, capturing its line-oriented output.

nodes.name: _import_sync_daemon_ready
nodes.summary: Best-effort import of sync_daemon and confirmation that phase3 writer symbols exist — a compile-time gate proving the deployed daemon build carries the writers Phase 3 depends on.

nodes.name: _observed_sync_mode
nodes.summary: Normalises the coordinator's raw sync-mode string (dual/coordinator/git-only) into the canonical observed-mode enum used by stage resolution and hub verdict evaluation.

nodes.name: _resolve_stage
nodes.summary: Reconciles an explicit --stage flag against the observed sync mode and writer-ready state to pick the effective cutover stage (pre-cutover, dual, coordinator-only), recording where the final choice came from for the report.

nodes.name: _evaluate_hub_sync_mode
nodes.summary: Judges whether the hub's observed sync mode is legal for the chosen cutover stage and whether the operator pinned it correctly, producing a CheckResult with detailed disagreement reasoning when mode and stage mismatch.

nodes.name: _evaluate_fleet_lifecycle
nodes.summary: Walks per-machine lifecycle records from the coordinator, resolves canonical machine identities (guarding against the DLAPTOP hostname-drift class), and flags any machine whose lifecycle_state is not a known-good value — the fleet-side readiness gate.

nodes.name: run_preflight
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full preflight sweep — reads env config, executes SSH/HTTP probes, calls the shadow-check helper, imports the sync daemon, resolves the effective stage, evaluates hub sync mode and fleet lifecycle — accumulating CheckResults into a single verdict payload.

nodes.name: _summary
nodes.summary: Rolls a list of CheckResult objects into a summary dict — counts pass/fail, isolates blocking failures, embeds the resolved stage, and stamps a UTC timestamp for the final report.

nodes.name: _verdict_lines
nodes.summary: Renders the summary dict into human-readable verdict lines describing overall pass/block state and per-category outcomes, formatted for direct terminal output.

nodes.name: _print_report
nodes.summary: Prints the full preflight report — header, per-check lines, and the aggregated verdict — to stdout in the human-facing report mode.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point — parses argparse arguments (env file, stage override, dry-run, mock, quiet, JSON output), invokes run_preflight, and emits either JSON or a human report, exiting non-zero when blocking checks fail.

nodes.name: e1_deep.py
nodes.summary: E1DeepPredictor — LSTM-based long-horizon world model with ContextMemory; the 2026-08-29 SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training ITEM 1 landing widened the transition_rnn input to include an action_encoder channel and added action-arg plumbing through predict_long_horizon / forward via the new _prepare_action_sequence normaliser (gated by E1Config.action_conditioned_transition).
nodes.languageNotes: Action-conditioned path is off by default; when enabled, the LSTM gets a dedicated action channel rather than back-projecting action into total_dim.

nodes.name: ContextMemory
nodes.summary: Slot-based associative memory with gated content-write, Gumbel-softmax write addressing, usage balancing, and refractory constraints; provides a queryable context vector to the E1 predictor before each rollout.

nodes.name: E1DeepPredictor
nodes.summary: V3 long-horizon world model: LSTM transition over [z_self, z_world] with ContextMemory-conditioned prior, schema readouts, and (as of 2026-08-29 SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training ITEM 1) an optional action-conditioned transition wired via action_encoder + widened transition_rnn.

nodes.name: _prepare_action_sequence
nodes.summary: Normalises an action argument to [batch, horizon, action_dim], accepting either a single held action or a per-step sequence; falls back to zeros and increments _action_cond_missing_calls when actions is None, and holds the final action when a shorter sequence is provided (never silently truncates the rollout).
nodes.languageNotes: New method landed 2026-08-29 for SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training ITEM 1; handles the two consumer families — agent-loop efference-copy vs candidate-sequence evaluator.

nodes.name: predict_long_horizon
nodes.summary: Rolls the LSTM transition forward over a horizon of latent states, optionally conditioned on an action sequence via action_encoder + widened transition_rnn input; used by both the agent-loop efference-copy path and candidate-sequence evaluators.
nodes.languageNotes: Widened 2026-08-29 to accept an `actions` argument passed through _prepare_action_sequence and concatenated with the state as LSTM input.

nodes.name: forward
nodes.summary: nn.Module forward pass — concatenates z_goal projection onto the current state and dispatches to predict_long_horizon (with the propagated action argument since 2026-08-29) plus generate_prior.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: Pure-stdlib HTTP coordinator (Flask-free ThreadingHTTPServer) exposing bearer-authed endpoints for experiment queue claims, task-claim registry mutations, chip ledger operations, workspace-state append spool (PHASE-4), recommendation log append, dispatcher lease upsert, and chip-episode records. Serves as the coordination-plane API layer for the Phase-3 coordinator on the hub.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses BaseHTTPRequestHandler subclass (Handler) with per-endpoint helper functions (_tc_*, _chip_*, _ws_append, _reclog_append) for clean separation of parsing/validation from DB mutations. ASCII-only prints for cp1252 safety.

nodes.name: Handler
nodes.summary: BaseHTTPRequestHandler subclass implementing the full coordinator HTTP surface: GET /health, /queue, /queue/active, /shadow/status, /commands, /task_claims/*, /chips/*, and POST endpoints for /claim, /heartbeat, /status, /result, /queue/add, /task_claims/*, /chips/*, /workspace_state/append, /recommendation_log/append, /dispatcher_lease/upsert, /chips/episode.

nodes.name: _canon
nodes.summary: Canonicalises a machine name at the ingest boundary via machine_identity.canonical_machine_name, forwarding None safely. THE INGEST BOUNDARY is the only place this happens so every downstream reader sees consistent identity comparisons.

nodes.name: _read_writer_health
nodes.summary: Reads the sync_daemon writer-health sidecar JSON file (if configured) into a dict, returning empty on any I/O or parse error to keep /health resilient.

nodes.name: _age_out_errors
nodes.summary: Trims stale error entries from the writer-health payload according to the WRITER_ERROR_STALE_HOURS threshold so /health shows only recent issues.

nodes.name: auth_machine
nodes.summary: Validates the Authorization: Bearer <token> header against the JSON tokens.json map and returns the caller's machine label. Returns None on missing/malformed/unknown token so callers can respond 401.

nodes.name: _tc_open
nodes.summary: POST /task_claims/open handler: validates required fields, calls db.try_open_task_claim with arbitration semantics (verdict OWNER / OWNED_BY_OTHER / OVERLAP_ALLOWED), and returns the verdict + owning session details to the caller.

nodes.name: _tc_close
nodes.summary: POST /task_claims/close handler: flips a claim entry to status='done' via db.close_task_claim, requiring closed_at, completion_note, and (session_id, claimed_at) for disambiguation when a session owns multiple claims.

nodes.name: _tc_renew
nodes.summary: POST /task_claims/renew handler: extends a live claim's TTL via db.renew_task_claim. Part of the PHASE-2b ingest-authority set; the renew verb has coordinator-mirror representation so its git write can be suppressed on coordinator-mode boxes.

nodes.name: _tc_amend
nodes.summary: POST /task_claims/amend handler: corrects the completion_note on an already-closed claim via db.amend_task_claim, preserving prior text in completion_note_history. PHASE-2b coordinator mirror; the 2026-08-28 hollow-ack bug fix ensures the amend actually persists.

nodes.name: _tc_dedupe
nodes.summary: POST /task_claims/dedupe handler: removes byte-identical duplicate claim entries via db.dedupe_task_claim. Refuses on any field-level difference so no merge is inferred.

nodes.name: _chip_record
nodes.summary: POST /chips/record handler: registers a spawned chip in the ledger via db.record_chip, storing title/tldr/prompt/chip_ref for durable follow-on tracking outside the ephemeral spawn_task chip.

nodes.name: _chip_claim
nodes.summary: POST /chips/claim handler: marks a chip as claimed_by a specific session via db.try_claim_chip, arbitrating simultaneous claim attempts server-side.

nodes.name: _chip_unclaim
nodes.summary: POST /chips/unclaim handler: releases a chip's claim so a different session (or the same one after failure) can pick it up via db.unclaim_chip.

nodes.name: _chip_resolve
nodes.summary: POST /chips/resolve handler: marks a chip as done/withdrawn via db.resolve_chip. Supports resolve-by-chip_ref for self-reporting spawned sessions and resolve-by-task_id for the spawning session withdrawing its own suggestions.

nodes.name: _chip_attach
nodes.summary: POST /chips/attach handler: attaches a spawn_task task_id to an existing chip_ref via db.attach_chip so a chip minted before the harness returned an id can later be joined to its spawn_task suggestion.

nodes.name: _chip_amend_prompt
nodes.summary: POST /chips/amend_prompt handler: corrects a chip's stored prompt text via db.amend_chip_prompt, preserving prior text in prompt_history. Used to fix chips recorded with a placeholder before the record --prompt marker requirement.

nodes.name: _ws_append
nodes.summary: POST /workspace_state/append handler (PHASE-4): submits a WORKSPACE_STATE.md entry to the coordinator spool via db.submit_workspace_state_entry, so sessions can append durably without racing on the shared file. Requires session_id + entry_text.

nodes.name: _reclog_append
nodes.summary: POST /recommendation_log/append handler: submits a decision-ledger entry to the coordinator spool via db.submit_recommendation_log_entry, capturing AskUserQuestion outcomes for the recommendation-agreement audit trail.

nodes.name: _dispatcher_lease
nodes.summary: POST /dispatcher_lease/upsert handler: upserts a metaworker-dispatcher lease row via db.upsert_dispatcher_lease, recording the dispatcher's in-flight dispatch count and lease TTL for the cloud-scaler's veto logic.

nodes.name: _chip_episode
nodes.summary: POST /chips/episode handler: records a chip execution episode (dispatch attempt / retry / outcome) via db.record_chip_episode so the metaworker orchestrator can audit dispatch history without touching the ledger row.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point: reads bind host/port/token file/db path from env, calls db.init_db and manifest_spool.spool_root, then serves Handler on ThreadingHTTPServer indefinitely.

nodes.name: db.py
nodes.summary: SQLite persistence layer for the Phase-3 coordinator: schema migrations, atomic claim/queue arbitration, task-claim + chip-ledger ingest-authority (PHASE-2b with 3-way merge + tombstone-close on renew), workspace-state append spool (PHASE-4), recommendation-log append, dispatcher-lease upsert, chip-episode recording, heartbeat + shutdown-notice + machine-lifecycle classification, and orphan-claim recovery (time-based OR departure-based).
nodes.languageNotes: One module holds ~80 top-level functions; migrations are idempotent CREATE IF NOT EXISTS + ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, and every write path that arbitrates uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE to serialise check-and-insert atomically.

nodes.name: connect
nodes.summary: Opens/creates the coordinator SQLite database at the configured path, sets pragmas (WAL journal, foreign keys, busy timeout), and returns a connection ready for the migration + writer code paths.

nodes.name: _migrate_experiments
nodes.summary: Creates the experiments table (queue rows + claim state) on first init and applies additive column migrations for later fields.

nodes.name: _migrate_heartbeats
nodes.summary: Creates the heartbeats + heartbeat_status tables and applies additive column migrations for machine/lifecycle fields consumed by sync_daemon's phase3_heartbeat_writer.

nodes.name: _migrate_commands
nodes.summary: Creates the commands table used by the remote-control command channel (POST /commands/issue -> pending -> ack).

nodes.name: _migrate_heartbeat_log
nodes.summary: Creates the heartbeat_log lifecycle-transition table (start/finish/switch/idle/silent/restart events) that phase3-heartbeats commit prefix materialises.

nodes.name: _migrate_task_claim_chip_tables
nodes.summary: Creates the task_claims, chips, drift-log, and reconciliation tables PHASE-2b coordinator-authoritative for TASK_CLAIMS.json / TASK_CHIPS.json, including entry_json blob columns for lossless git rendering.

nodes.name: upsert_task_claim
nodes.summary: Ingest-authority upsert for a task_claims row from a rendered/received entry: 3-way merge against last_rendered_json to preserve concurrent field-level edits (PHASE-2b). Called by the sync-daemon reconciler and the coordinator's own mutation endpoints.

nodes.name: upsert_chip
nodes.summary: Ingest-authority upsert for a chips row with 3-way merge against last_rendered_json (PHASE-2b). Preserves concurrent claim/status/resolution field updates when reconciling against a stale git-rendered snapshot.

nodes.name: reconcile_task_claims
nodes.summary: Batched reconciliation entry point: walks the source-of-truth entries (from the git-rendered JSON) and calls upsert_task_claim for each, updating drift counters and last_rendered_json.

nodes.name: reconcile_chips
nodes.summary: Batched reconciliation entry point for chip ingest, mirroring reconcile_task_claims.

nodes.name: log_task_claim_chip_drift
nodes.summary: Appends a drift-detection event (source-truth vs coordinator-DB divergence) to the drift log table so the hub materialiser can surface persistent drift in a dashboard.

nodes.name: task_claim_chip_drift_summary
nodes.summary: Returns aggregated drift counts by kind (missing / extra / changed) over a rolling window, consumed by the writer-health readout.

nodes.name: _is_stale_at
nodes.summary: Predicate: is a claim row past its stale_after_hours cutoff (used by arbitration to exclude stale rivals).

nodes.name: _is_scope_resource
nodes.summary: Predicate: is a resource path directory-shaped (scope claim) rather than file-shaped (arbitrated resource).

nodes.name: try_open_task_claim
nodes.summary: Atomic task-claim open with server-side arbitration: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, rival check, insert (or verdict=OWNED_BY_OTHER). Returns OWNER on success, OWNED_BY_OTHER on refusal, OVERLAP_ALLOWED on scope claims / --allow-overlap. Backing the /task_claims/open endpoint.

nodes.name: close_task_claim
nodes.summary: Flips a claim row to status='done' with closed_at + completion_note, disambiguating on (session_id, claimed_at). Refuses if the (session_id, claimed_at) pair is absent or ambiguous.

nodes.name: renew_task_claim
nodes.summary: Extends a live claim's TTL. PHASE-2b enrichment: renews now also insert a tombstone-close row so a downstream reconciler recognises the intent even when the git write is suppressed on the coordinator path.

nodes.name: amend_task_claim
nodes.summary: Replaces a closed claim's completion_note while preserving prior text in completion_note_history. PHASE-2b coordinator mirror (2026-08-28 fix: no longer silently no-ops on the coordinator path).

nodes.name: dedupe_task_claim
nodes.summary: Removes byte-identical duplicate claim rows for a given session_id, refusing on any field-level difference.

nodes.name: record_chip
nodes.summary: Inserts (or upserts by chip_ref) a chip ledger row with title/tldr/prompt/task_id metadata. Enforces the [chip_ref: <ref>] marker requirement in the stored prompt so self-report resolves later.

nodes.name: try_claim_chip
nodes.summary: Server-side arbitrated chip claim: atomic BEGIN IMMEDIATE + rival check, mirrors try_open_task_claim's shape but for chip_ref keys.

nodes.name: unclaim_chip
nodes.summary: Releases a chip's claim (clears claimed_by / claimed_at) so a different session can pick it up.

nodes.name: resolve_chip
nodes.summary: Marks a chip done/withdrawn with resolved_by / resolution_note. Supports resolve-by-chip_ref (self-report) and resolve-by-task_id (spawn withdrawal).

nodes.name: attach_chip
nodes.summary: Attaches a spawn_task task_id to an existing chip_ref row so a chip minted before the harness returned an id can be joined to its spawn suggestion later.

nodes.name: amend_chip_prompt
nodes.summary: Replaces a chip's stored prompt while preserving prior text in prompt_history. Used to fix chips recorded with a placeholder before the marker requirement.

nodes.name: _migrate_workspace_state_table
nodes.summary: Creates the workspace_state_entries spool table (PHASE-4 dual-write soak infrastructure) for the POST /workspace_state/append endpoint.

nodes.name: submit_workspace_state_entry
nodes.summary: Appends a WORKSPACE_STATE.md entry to the coordinator spool table (PHASE-4). Called by POST /workspace_state/append; the hub materialiser drains the spool into the shared file.

nodes.name: mark_workspace_state_entries_materialized
nodes.summary: Called by the hub materialiser to acknowledge which spool entries have been folded into WORKSPACE_STATE.md and can be retired.

nodes.name: _migrate_recommendation_log_table
nodes.summary: Creates the recommendation_log_entries spool table for the decision-ledger append endpoint.

nodes.name: submit_recommendation_log_entry
nodes.summary: Appends a recommendation-outcome entry to the decision-ledger spool table. Consumed by POST /recommendation_log/append and materialised by the hub writer.

nodes.name: mark_recommendation_log_entries_materialized
nodes.summary: Marks recommendation_log entries as materialised by the hub writer so they can be retired.

nodes.name: _migrate_dispatcher_leases_table
nodes.summary: Creates the dispatcher_leases table used by the metaworker orchestrator's cloud-scaler veto logic.

nodes.name: upsert_dispatcher_lease
nodes.summary: Upserts a metaworker-dispatcher lease row (machine, in_flight_dispatches, chips_open_work, lease_expires_at). Consumed by /dispatcher_lease/upsert; the cloud-scaler reads it to veto shutdowns.

nodes.name: record_chip_episode
nodes.summary: Records a chip execution episode row (dispatch attempt, retry, outcome). Called by /chips/episode; enables the orchestrator to audit dispatch history without mutating the primary ledger row.

nodes.name: init_db
nodes.summary: Initialises all migrations for a fresh coordinator DB in one call. Idempotent by design: each _migrate_* helper is CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS.

nodes.name: upsert_experiment
nodes.summary: Upserts a queue-experiment row into the experiments table from POST /queue/add (or the shadow queue-writer path).

nodes.name: _claim_recoverable
nodes.summary: Predicate for orphaned-claim recovery: EITHER stale-by-time (>= STALE_HOURS with no fresh owner heartbeat) OR orphaned-by-departure (machine shutdown announced and silence >= REAP_QUIET_SECONDS). Reduces V3-EXQ-841's orphan window from ~10h to ~20min.

nodes.name: claim_fence_active
nodes.summary: Returns True iff a claim-fence row (posted by /shutdown_notify) is active for this machine and hasn't been cleared by a subsequent poweron. Used to prevent claims by machines mid-shutdown.

nodes.name: machine_claim_fenced
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper around claim_fence_active for the try_claim admission path.

nodes.name: record_claim_fence_clear
nodes.summary: Marks the claim-fence for a machine as cleared (usually on poweron).

nodes.name: machine_departed
nodes.summary: Returns True iff a machine has posted /shutdown_notify with a reason outside PROCESS_EXIT_SHUTDOWN_REASONS AND has since been silent for >= REAP_QUIET_SECONDS. The 'positive departure signal' the claim reaper reads.

nodes.name: machine_has_departed
nodes.summary: Convenience read alongside machine_departed for the /shadow/status readout so operators can see per-machine departed flags.

nodes.name: claim_orphaned_by_departure
nodes.summary: Sub-predicate of _claim_recoverable: is this specific claim's owner machine departed?

nodes.name: try_claim
nodes.summary: Atomic queue-claim admission (BEGIN IMMEDIATE): checks affinity, claim fence, running-vs-runnable state, and orphan-recoverability, then either marks claimed_by or returns a refusal reason. The main worker POST /claim endpoint's core logic.

nodes.name: evaluate_claim
nodes.summary: Read-only counterpart to try_claim used by dry-run and shadow-mode paths to predict what try_claim would decide without mutating state.

nodes.name: apply_git_outcome
nodes.summary: Reflects the git-side claim commit outcome back into the DB row (legacy git-based claim mutex support).

nodes.name: release_claim
nodes.summary: Clears claimed_by / claimed_at on a queue row (clean release path on runner shutdown or explicit release_claim command).

nodes.name: mark_queue_removed
nodes.summary: Marks a queue row as removed (post-completion or explicit dequeue) so phase3_queue_writer materialises the deletion.

nodes.name: claim_verdicts_diverge
nodes.summary: Predicate for the divergence audit: does the DB's authoritative claim state disagree with what the git snapshot says the worker should be running?

nodes.name: divergence_stats
nodes.summary: Returns rolled-up divergence counters for the writer-health readout.

nodes.name: record_result
nodes.summary: Persists a result manifest blob for a queue_id (POST /result -> DB -> sync_daemon.phase3_git_writer materialises to REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/<run_id>.json).

nodes.name: trim_heartbeat_log
nodes.summary: Drops old heartbeat_log rows past the retention window to keep the lifecycle-log table bounded.

nodes.name: upsert_heartbeat
nodes.summary: Upsert for a POST /heartbeat payload: updates the heartbeats row, emits a lifecycle-transition event into heartbeat_log on state changes (start/finish/switch/idle/silent/restart), and computes state_change_at.

nodes.name: record_status_payload
nodes.summary: Persists a POST /status payload (per-machine runtime status snapshot). Consumed by sync_daemon.phase3_heartbeat_writer to materialise runner_status/*.json.

nodes.name: record_shutdown_notice
nodes.summary: Persists a POST /shutdown_notify payload including reason. Feeds machine_departed's positive-departure detector.

nodes.name: announced_offline_at
nodes.summary: Returns the timestamp at which a machine last announced going offline (used for the CLI /shadow/status display).

nodes.name: lifecycle_state
nodes.summary: Returns the coordinator's assessment of a machine's lifecycle state (stale / gracefully_offline / departed / active) from heartbeat + shutdown-notice rows.

nodes.name: insert_command
nodes.summary: Inserts a pending command row (kind/args/target machine/issued_by) via POST /commands/issue. Runners drain via GET /commands and ack via /commands/ack.

nodes.name: ack_command
nodes.summary: Marks a command as acked with result_status/result_note. Called from POST /commands/ack on the runner side.

nodes.name: task_claim_chip_git_writer.py
nodes.summary: Hub-only materialiser: renders the coordinator DB's task_claims + chips + workspace_state_entries (PHASE-4) + recommendation_log_entries spools into their git-tracked shapes (TASK_CLAIMS.json, TASK_CHIPS.json, WORKSPACE_STATE.md, decision-log JSONL) and commits with phase2b:/phase4: prefixes on state change. THE single git writer for these files since the 2026-08-28 cutover.
nodes.languageNotes: State-change-only commit gate via _texts_match + _semantic_delta so telemetry writers don't churn git history; last_rendered_json writeback provides the 3-way-merge base the next ingest cycle needs to preserve concurrent field-level edits.

nodes.name: _fetch_and_resolve
nodes.summary: Fetches origin and resolves the target branch's tip commit for the writer's rebase-onto step.

nodes.name: _parse_iso
nodes.summary: Parses an ISO-8601 timestamp string into a UTC datetime, tolerating trailing Z.

nodes.name: _source_order
nodes.summary: Deterministic key for ordering rendered entries (session_id + claimed_at, chip_ref) so the materialised file is stable across runs.

nodes.name: render_task_claims
nodes.summary: Renders the coordinator DB's task_claims table into the git-tracked TASK_CLAIMS.json shape, applying the >24h done-entry retention filter and ordering rows deterministically. The ONE git writer for TASK_CLAIMS.json since the 2026-08-28 cutover.

nodes.name: render_chips
nodes.summary: Renders the coordinator DB's chips table into the git-tracked TASK_CHIPS.json shape. Sister renderer to render_task_claims; both drive the git-write half of the PHASE-2b coordinator-authoritative registries.

nodes.name: _ws_render_guards
nodes.summary: Precondition/guard checks applied before rendering the WORKSPACE_STATE.md spool into the shared file (PHASE-4): confirms writer identity, checks for concurrent edits, refuses on conflicts.

nodes.name: render_workspace_state
nodes.summary: Drains the workspace_state_entries spool table (PHASE-4) and appends new entries to WORKSPACE_STATE.md, then marks them materialised via db.mark_workspace_state_entries_materialized. Idempotent by construction.

nodes.name: render_recommendation_log
nodes.summary: Drains the recommendation_log_entries spool table and appends new entries to the decision-log JSONL file, then marks them materialised. Idempotent.

nodes.name: ingest_dispatcher_control
nodes.summary: Reads the dispatcher-control side file (operator-authored knobs) and returns the parsed control payload for consumption by the render pass.

nodes.name: render_dispatcher_control
nodes.summary: Renders the coordinator's view of the dispatcher-lease state back into the dispatcher-control side file so operators see the live lease view.

nodes.name: ingest
nodes.summary: Umbrella ingest phase: pulls the current git-side JSON documents into memory so the writer's 3-way merge can compare against last_rendered_json.

nodes.name: _writeback_rendered_base
nodes.summary: Persists the rendered JSON payload back into last_rendered_json for each row after a successful materialisation, giving the next ingest cycle its 3-way-merge base.

nodes.name: _texts_match
nodes.summary: Byte-comparison helper used to short-circuit no-op commits when the newly-rendered content matches what's already on disk.

nodes.name: _semantic_delta
nodes.summary: Structured diff (added/removed/changed counts) used in the state-change-only commit gate so telemetry writers commit only on material change.

nodes.name: materialize_once
nodes.summary: One materialisation cycle: ingest last-rendered snapshots, render all four sources (task_claims, chips, workspace_state, recommendation_log) + dispatcher_control, detect changes via _texts_match/_semantic_delta, write files, commit with phase2b:/phase4: prefixes, and writeback the rendered base. Called on a 2-min timer on the hub.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point: parses env config, runs materialize_once in a loop with the configured interval, catches and reports failures without crashing the timer.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: The substrate's monolithic dataclass-of-dataclasses config registry: every flag governing the REE substrate is a field on one of 16 nested config dataclasses, unified by REEConfig and its from_dims factory that wires dim/kwarg inputs into the whole tree.
nodes.languageNotes: Python dataclasses used as an aggregate configuration schema; enforces a three-site wiring pattern (field + from_dims signature param + from_dims body assignment) documented in project CLAUDE.md.

nodes.name: derive_stdlib_rng_seed
nodes.summary: Deterministic mixing helper that derives a stdlib-safe RNG seed from a base seed and a named stream, used by from_dims to seed independent random streams without collision.

nodes.name: LatentStackConfig
nodes.summary: Parameters for the multi-scale latent representation stack (L0..L3 encoders), covering dimensions, normalization, gating, and the assortment of consistency-loss and freezing options that shape how observations become z_world.

nodes.name: E1Config
nodes.summary: Configuration for the E1 world-model / transition predictor, including recent additions for action-conditioned transitions (action_conditioned_transition, action_dim, action_cond_unzero_self_slot) landed 2026-08-29 for the SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training work.

nodes.name: E2Config
nodes.summary: Configuration for the E2 error/feature predictor, parametrising its input coupling, loss weights, and diagnostic switches within the three-predictor hierarchy.

nodes.name: E3Config
nodes.summary: Configuration for the E3 action / policy selector — the largest sub-config, covering CEM sampling, policy decomposition, mode-conditioning, temperature schedules, defensive-orienting, and the many diagnostic and staleness knobs the E3 selector exposes.

nodes.name: EventSegmenterScaleConfig
nodes.summary: Per-scale parameters for the event-segmenter — one instance per temporal scale, holding thresholds and window sizes that govern that scale's boundary detection.

nodes.name: EventSegmenterConfig
nodes.summary: Top-level event-segmenter configuration that composes multiple EventSegmenterScaleConfig instances and holds cross-scale coordination flags.

nodes.name: InvalidationTriggerConfig
nodes.summary: Thresholds and enable flags for the invalidation-trigger mechanism that fires when accumulated evidence contradicts a currently-held prediction or anchor.

nodes.name: AnchorSetConfig
nodes.summary: Hippocampal anchor-set configuration — capacity, admission policy, distance metric, and anchor-goal payload handling for the anchor memory used to seed goals and pattern-completion.

nodes.name: StalenessAccumulatorConfig
nodes.summary: Parameters for the staleness accumulator that tracks how out-of-date a cached prediction or anchor has become, used to trigger refresh or invalidation.

nodes.name: GhostGoalBankConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the ghost-goal bank — counterfactual and off-policy goal storage, including admission thresholds, decay, and the coalition-controller interactions on candidate goal selection.

nodes.name: PersistenceAppraisalComputeConfig
nodes.summary: Small container for the persistence-appraisal compute mode toggles — kept as its own dataclass so downstream modules can pass it around without dragging in the whole hippocampal config.

nodes.name: HippocampalConfig
nodes.summary: Aggregate hippocampal-memory configuration — anchor bank, pattern completion, retrieval gating, phase-aware theta interactions, and the persistence-appraisal wiring that connects the hippocampal system to the rest of the substrate.

nodes.name: ResidueConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the residue (care-marker) subsystem central to INV-001, including the residue-valence-bound knobs and the coupling parameters that link residue signals to mood regulation and goal persistence.

nodes.name: HeartbeatConfig
nodes.summary: Heartbeat/lifecycle configuration — tick cadence, sleep-cycle triggering, and the wiring that lets from_dims optionally enable the sleep-aggregation cluster when its knob is set.

nodes.name: EnvironmentConfig
nodes.summary: Small dataclass carrying environment-facing parameters (observation/action space shape, episode length, and related boundary knobs) kept separate so environment wiring is not confused with substrate wiring.

nodes.name: REEConfig
nodes.summary: The master substrate config — a 6.4k-line dataclass composing every sub-config and exposing ~690 top-level fields plus __post_init__ validation, the load-bearing from_dims factory, enable_sleep_aggregation_cluster / enable_goal_stream helpers, and preset sizings (large, xlarge).
nodes.languageNotes: from_dims is the single canonical construction path — it applies the three-site wiring rule (field + signature param + assignment) and is where every new substrate knob must land to be reachable from experiment scripts.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel entry point for the ree_core.policy sub-package that re-exports the family of pure-arithmetic policy-layer regulators — NoiseFloor (MECH-313), StructuredCuriosity (MECH-314), TonicVigor (MECH-320), CommitMaintenanceRelease (MECH-342), CommitReadiness (MECH-090 R-c), CandidateRuleField (ARC-063), GatedPolicy (ARC-062), PolicyChunking (ARC-071), PolicyDecomposition (ARC-070), and the newly landed EpistemicDeficitAccumulator (SD-102 / MECH-482). Consumed as the canonical import surface by REEAgent and downstream experiment drivers.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure Python re-export barrel with explicit __all__ list — 13 sub-modules aggregated behind one import namespace; no runtime logic beyond imports.

nodes.name: schema.sql
nodes.summary: Idempotent SQLite schema (WAL mode) for the Phase-3 experiment coordinator hub, defining 13 tables that mirror the git-authoritative experiment queue, TASK_CLAIMS/TASK_CHIPS registries, machine heartbeats, remote-control commands, and PHASE-4 append-only spool intake for WORKSPACE_STATE.md / RECOMMENDATION_LOG.jsonl / dispatcher leases.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive inline SQL comments encode design rationale for D1-D11 tradeoffs, orphan/retention semantics, and coordinator-vs-git authority boundaries. Uses IF NOT EXISTS + PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON for idempotent startup migration; composite PKs on task_claims/task_claim_resources preserve the (session_id, claimed_at) key contract; partial UNIQUE index on chip_ledger.task_id handles nullable task_id.

nodes.name: experiments
nodes.summary: One row per experiment queue item, mirroring the validate_queue.py item schema for experiment_queue.json; carries lossless item_json plus removal_reason/removed_at to distinguish operator cancellation from FAIL/ERROR terminations.

nodes.name: results
nodes.summary: One row per completed experiment run keyed by run_id (idempotent delivery), holding the manifest bytes + sha256 for the phase3 sync_daemon to commit into REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/.

nodes.name: heartbeats
nodes.summary: Latest per-machine heartbeat tick keyed by machine, distinguishing machine shutdowns (last_shutdown_at/shutdown_reason -- arms the claim fence) from runner-process exits (last_process_exit_at -- does not fence); carries verbatim JSON payloads for downstream file materialization.

nodes.name: commands
nodes.summary: Pending and recently-acked remote-control commands per machine (pause/resume/stop/kick/release_claim/reclassify); pending while acked_at IS NULL, retained post-ack as an audit trail.

nodes.name: heartbeat_log
nodes.summary: Append-only heartbeat history sibling of `heartbeats`, written only on (state, current_exq) transitions (not per tick) with 30-day retention trimming to answer historical liveness questions without unbounded growth.

nodes.name: claim_log
nodes.summary: Shadow audit of experiment claim attempts comparing git's arbitration verdict against the coordinator's own logic; diverged=1 rows are the operator's signal before advancing past Phase 1.

nodes.name: task_claims
nodes.summary: One row per TASK_CLAIMS.json claim, PHASE-1 shadow mirror; COMPOSITE PK (session_id, claimed_at) preserves the claim key contract (session_id alone is ambiguous -- 8/154 live session_ids own multiple claims as of 2026-08-26).

nodes.name: task_claim_resources
nodes.summary: Child table for the resources[] list on each task_claims row (design D2 -- list-as-child not JSON column), FK-cascaded on delete; enables single-indexed rival lookups inside Phase-2 BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions instead of whole-table JSON scans.

nodes.name: chip_ledger
nodes.summary: One row per TASK_CHIPS.json chip keyed by chip_ref; task_id is NULL for un-clicked chips (partial UNIQUE index) and carries origin/urgency/claim/resolution lifecycle plus append-only history JSON arrays for prompt/urgency/resolution_note (D5 archival semantics).

nodes.name: task_claim_chip_drift_log
nodes.summary: Shadow soak evidence: one row per reconciliation tick of task_claim_chip_shadow_sync.py; drift rows (diverged=1) are always anomalous because TASK_CLAIMS/TASK_CHIPS are append-only registries. Feeds the N-days-of-zero-drift PHASE-1 exit criterion.

nodes.name: workspace_state_entries
nodes.summary: PHASE-4 first slice: append-only spool for WORKSPACE_STATE.md entries POSTed by clients; the registry materializer SPLICES pending rows into the live file byte-preservingly and marks them materialized once the text provably reached git. No ingest of existing entries, no edit/delete verb.

nodes.name: recommendation_log_entries
nodes.summary: PHASE-4 fleet-wedge campaign slice: append-only spool for RECOMMENDATION_LOG.jsonl lines POSTed by clients; the materializer appends verbatim jsonl bytes (trivial case of the WS splice) and marks each line materialized once it reaches git.

nodes.name: dispatcher_leases
nodes.summary: PHASE-4 dispatcher run-lease intake keyed by dispatcher: the Orchestrator's grant/stop commands become DB state POSTed to /dispatcher/lease; the materializer renders dispatcher_control.json from these rows AND ingests git-side writes (upsert-if-newer), preserving the git file as an emergency STOP fallback when the hub is unreachable (RT3).

nodes.name: agent.py
nodes.summary: The central REEAgent orchestrator of the REE V3 cognitive architecture: wires perception (sense/encode via the latent stack), the multi-rate E1/E2/E3 predictor loop, action selection with dozens of modulatory bias channels (dACC, lateral-PFC, OFC, curiosity, tonic vigor, coalition gating), the BetaGate commitment latch, goal/wanting pipeline, residue-field valence writes, and SWS/REM sleep cycles into one agent class.
nodes.languageNotes: A ~12,000-line god-class module: nearly every subsystem is an optional, flag-gated (no-op-default) component instantiated in __init__ and consulted through None-guarded call sites, preserving bit-identical behaviour when features are off.

nodes.name: REEAgent
nodes.summary: The full REE agent with 101 methods spanning sensing (sense/sense_flat), E1/E3 ticks and trajectory generation, select_action with commitment/urgency/coalition gating, actor-critic hooks, policy chunking/decomposition, goal seeding (update_z_goal), a dozen auxiliary training losses, serotonin/sleep-mode transitions (enter_sws_mode/run_sleep_cycle), and diagnostic state export.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of getattr-fallback config reads and Optional subsystem attributes so that dozens of experimental substrates (MECH-*/SD-* features) compose without changing default behaviour.

nodes.name: AgentState
nodes.summary: Lightweight dataclass-style container holding the agent's per-tick state snapshot passed between the perception and selection stages.

nodes.name: candidate_support_preflight
nodes.summary: Module-level preflight check that validates a candidate trajectory pool has sufficient support (e.g. distinct first-action classes) before selection, guarding experiments against degenerate single-class candidate sets.

nodes.name: _resolve_chunk_deliberation_horizon
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective deliberation horizon for ARC-071 policy-chunking budgets: a sentinel value of 0 mirrors the hippocampal rollout horizon while explicit positive overrides are honoured verbatim.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for the claustrum-analog substrate (SD-091 / MECH-481): re-exports the ControlDemandType taxonomy, the two MVP coalition templates, and the CoalitionController primitive, with a docstring documenting the MVP scope and the default-off, bit-identical-when-disabled guarantee.
nodes.languageNotes: Python package barrel using explicit __all__; the module docstring doubles as the SD-091 scope-of-record note.

nodes.name: coalition_controller.py
nodes.summary: Core of the SD-091 coalition/topology control substrate: a non-trainable star-topology controller that opens typed control-demand coalitions from static templates, ticks them toward timeout or completion-condition dissolution, and exposes write_gate/channel_gain multipliers that consumer sites in the agent loop multiply into their existing signals.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-arithmetic dataclass-based regulator (no nn.Module, no learned parameters); write gates are clamped attenuation-only (<= 1.0) while channel gains may exceed 1.0 -- a deliberate asymmetry documented in the SD-091 design.

nodes.name: coalition_templates.py
nodes.summary: Static COALITION_TEMPLATES registry mapping the two MVP-templated control-demand types (SENSORY_RESAMPLE, PROVENANCE_CHECK) to frozen recruit/suppress/channel-gain weight dictionaries over named consumer targets (E1 encoder, E2 forward model, hippocampal anchor set, BetaGate commitment sites, etc.), with placeholder magnitudes chosen to be numerically distinguishable at every site.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclass template plus a module-level dict registry; the extensive docstring carries the target-name-to-module map that consumer wiring (SD-091 steps 4-5) follows.

nodes.name: control_demand.py
nodes.summary: Declares the 10-class MECH-481 typed control-demand taxonomy as the ControlDemandType enum, of which only SENSORY_RESAMPLE and PROVENANCE_CHECK are templated in the MVP; the other eight members are declared-but-untemplated pending their own consumer substrate.
nodes.languageNotes: Leaf module with zero imports -- the dependency root of the claustrum package.

nodes.name: CoalitionState
nodes.summary: Live state for one open coalition: per-target participating/suppressed weights (re-clamped to [0,1] in __post_init__) and channel gains, plus the per-request lifecycle fields (opened_tick, max_duration_ticks, completion_condition) consulted by coalition_gate and should_dissolve.

nodes.name: CoalitionControllerConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration dataclass for the controller: master enabled switch (default False, bit-identical off), the tuple of templated demand types allowed, the default coalition timeout in ticks, and the global channel-gain scale.

nodes.name: CoalitionController
nodes.summary: The star-topology coalition primitive: request_coalition() instantiates a CoalitionState from a COALITION_TEMPLATES entry, tick() dissolves timed-out or completed coalitions, and write_gate()/channel_gain() compose multipliers across all active coalitions for a named consumer target; recruited_targets/suppressed_targets expose the current topology and reset() clears state on episode boundaries.

nodes.name: CoalitionTemplate
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding the static recruit (participating), suppress, and channel-gain weight dictionaries for one ControlDemandType; consumed by CoalitionController.request_coalition() to build a live CoalitionState, which re-validates the weights itself.

nodes.name: ControlDemandType
nodes.summary: Enum of the ten MECH-481 typed control-demand classes (e.g. sensory resample, provenance check, plus eight declared-but-untemplated members) that key coalition template lookup and the CoalitionController's types_enabled gating.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for the REE preservation subsystem, re-exporting the ReconstructionRecord primitives, archive backends, and physical-token exporter that together make a REE organism reconstructable from birth inputs.
nodes.languageNotes: Python package barrel with an explicit __all__ covering all three submodules.

nodes.name: archive.py
nodes.summary: Content-addressed, append-only archive backends (local filesystem, S3-compatible object stores, multi-store replication) with optional client-side AES-256-GCM encryption for storing ReconstructionRecords durably.
nodes.languageNotes: Lazy imports of cryptography and boto3 keep top-level imports stdlib-only; object keys embed the record's sha256 hash, making stores append-only by construction.

nodes.name: reconstruction_record.py
nodes.summary: Defines ReconstructionRecord, an immutable integrity-hashed bundle of the exact inputs (config, seed, environment, provenance, understanding) that deterministically reproduce one REE life, plus faithful REEConfig JSON round-tripping and append-only file persistence.
nodes.languageNotes: Custom dataclass serializer/deserializer preserves tuple-typed config fields that plain JSON would flatten to lists; integrity is a sha256 over canonical (sorted-key, compact-separator) JSON bytes.

nodes.name: token.py
nodes.summary: Physical-token exporter: writes an engravable ~180-byte key line, a gzipped full record, a manifest, a human-readable README, and an optional QR code so a preserved organism survives all-digital failure.
nodes.languageNotes: Stdlib-only at import time; the QR backend (segno or qrcode) is discovered lazily and is optional, with an injectable backend seam for tests.

nodes.name: NoEncryption
nodes.summary: Identity encryptor that stores plaintext JSON; the default Encryptor implementation.

nodes.name: AesGcmEncryptor
nodes.summary: Client-side AES-256-GCM encryptor with key generation, base64 env-var loading, and a nonce-prefixed ciphertext format so the object store only ever sees ciphertext.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports the cryptography package lazily inside the class so the module stays importable without it.

nodes.name: _BaseArchive
nodes.summary: Abstract archive base implementing content-addressed put/load/exists over the record's integrity hash, verifying integrity on both write and read and refusing to overwrite an existing key.

nodes.name: LocalArchive
nodes.summary: Filesystem archive backend writing records atomically (temp file + os.replace) under a local root directory; the hot copy that tests exercise.

nodes.name: S3Archive
nodes.summary: S3-compatible object-store archive backend (intended node 1: Hetzner Object Storage) with lazy boto3 client construction, injectable clients, and head_object-based existence checks.
nodes.languageNotes: boto3 is imported only when no client is injected, keeping ree_core import-light.

nodes.name: MultiArchive
nodes.summary: Replicating wrapper that puts a record into several archives and can verify a record loads with matching integrity from each backend.

nodes.name: s3_archive_from_env
nodes.summary: Factory building an S3Archive from a group-prefixed set of environment variables (endpoint, bucket, credentials), with an injectable client factory for tests.

nodes.name: IntegrityError
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a record's integrity hash fails verification or is malformed.

nodes.name: RecordExistsError
nodes.summary: Exception raised when an append-only write would overwrite an already-stored record.

nodes.name: ReconstructionRecord
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass bundling record_id, seed, serialized config, environment spec, provenance, understanding, lifetime context, schema version, and the sha256 integrity hash of one REE life's birth inputs.

nodes.name: _import_dataclass
nodes.summary: Resolves a dotted ree_core-only path back to a dataclass type during deserialization, refusing anything outside the ree_core namespace.

nodes.name: _ser
nodes.summary: Recursive serializer converting nested dataclasses, tuples, lists, and dicts into JSON-safe structures while recording each dataclass's import path and tuple-ness for faithful round-tripping.

nodes.name: _de
nodes.summary: Recursive deserializer that rebuilds dataclasses and tuple-typed fields from the tagged JSON structures _ser produced.

nodes.name: config_to_dict
nodes.summary: Serializes an REEConfig into a plain JSON-safe dict via the recursive _ser encoder.

nodes.name: config_from_dict
nodes.summary: Rebuilds an REEConfig from its serialized dict, raising if the round-trip does not yield an REEConfig instance.

nodes.name: compute_integrity
nodes.summary: Computes the record's sha256 integrity hash over canonical JSON bytes of every field except the integrity field itself.

nodes.name: verify_integrity
nodes.summary: Returns whether a record's stored integrity string matches a freshly recomputed hash.

nodes.name: capture
nodes.summary: Builds a complete ReconstructionRecord from a live config, seed, environment spec, and caller-supplied provenance, asserting the config round-trips exactly before stamping the integrity hash.

nodes.name: reconstruct_config
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the original REEConfig from a stored record's serialized config dict, the read-side of birth-replay reconstruction.

nodes.name: to_json
nodes.summary: Serializes a ReconstructionRecord to a JSON string.

nodes.name: from_json
nodes.summary: Parses a JSON string back into a ReconstructionRecord dataclass.

nodes.name: write_record
nodes.summary: Persists a verified record to an archive directory atomically (temp file + os.replace), refusing to overwrite an existing record to preserve append-only semantics.

nodes.name: load_record
nodes.summary: Loads a record from disk and re-checks its integrity hash, raising IntegrityError on mismatch.

nodes.name: record_key_line
nodes.summary: Builds the ~180-byte engravable key line (scheme, id, seed, substrate commit, machine class, sha256) that locates and authenticates a record without containing its config.

nodes.name: parse_key_line
nodes.summary: Parses a pipe-delimited key line back into its field dict, validating the KEY_SCHEME prefix.

nodes.name: _default_qr_backend
nodes.summary: Lazily discovers an installed QR library (segno preferred, qrcode fallback) and returns a backend wrapper, or None so non-QR artifacts are still produced.

nodes.name: export_token
nodes.summary: Writes the full physical-token artifact set for a record into an output directory: key-line text, gzipped record, manifest with file hashes, README with verify/reconstruct instructions, and optional QR SVG/PNG.

nodes.name: _main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that loads a (possibly gzipped) record file, verifies its integrity, and exports the token artifact set, printing each written file.

layers.name: Environment
layers.description: CausalGridWorld gridworld env plus the InvariantTypes registry that defines the sensory / action interface the V3 agent lives in.

layers.name: Latent Stack + Predictors
layers.description: Split latent-space (z_self / z_world / harm streams, cross-stream binder) plus E1 / E2 / E3 forward and selector predictors that produce world-model estimates, candidate trajectories and per-candidate value/confidence signals.

layers.name: Hippocampal + Residue
